claims.statement: For every finite real Williamson coefficient list, all real vectors u,v and m>=1, t_m(u,v,...,v)=b^T R_v^(m-1)u/m!.
limitations: Finite checks do not independently prove the universal quantifiers.

claims.statement: For 1<=p<=6, classical order-p conditions imply consistency order at least p for the specified left-multiplication exponential lift.
limitations: Global convergence has additional regularity hypotheses.
No prescribed-stage coefficient existence or performance claim.

claims.statement: Classical order seven plus the three additional tensor equalities in Theorem 7 imply consistency order seven.
limitations: Automatic satisfaction of the three equalities is not proved.
Their independence on genuine coefficient lists is not established.
